environment.description: Same binary deployed to ECS Fargate behind internal ALB. Split.io SDK key references workspace 'platform-core' environment 'production-eu-west' where flag 'enable-legacy-session-cleanup' has kill switch engaged: the flag definition uses a dependent prerequisite on flag 'legacy-migration-complete' (evaluates to 'off' for all identities since 2024-01-15 when migration was halted). The targeting rules specify individual percentage rollout at 0% with default treatment 'off'. SDK operates in streaming mode with SSE connection to Split cloud; if connection drops, SDK falls back to in-memory cache which was seeded with 'off' state at initialization. Additionally, the SPLIT_SDK_KEY environment variable is injected via AWS Secrets Manager rotation (rotated every 24h) ensuring SDK always authenticates and receives current flag state rather than falling through to code-level defaults.
